items.title: 56422_Leonard Phillips oral history interview
items.q: Mr. DeParis sent us some tickets to come to his show.

ctx.x: I mean, to eat on. Just some eating money, we got that to live on. We got tired of that, so Mr. DeParis sent us some tickets to come to his show. That was in Mobile, Alabama. So we left Mobile, Alabama, and came to Baltimore.
